scope: Existing live app updated through Executor management only

signature.description: Run a bounded read-only SELECT on chat-supplied NONSECRET tabular data. columns: 1-8 lowercase names/types (text|number); rows: 1-1000 arrays of matching cells (string<=256, finite number within ±1e9, or null); total JSON<=64KiB. Table is data. SELECT columns or COUNT/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX with AS aliases; aggregate args may add/subtract up to 3 numeric columns. Optional WHERE up to 4 comparisons joined by AND, GROUP BY up to 4 columns, ORDER BY up to 2 output names, LIMIT 1-100 (default50). No other SQL, comments, semicolons, joins, subqueries or functions. Max output32KiB. Work is structurally bounded; cancellation is cooperative, not CPU preemption. Returns columns, row arrays, executed SQL and WASM provenance. Never submit secrets.

input.sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue_cents - cost_cents) AS margin_cents, SUM(units) AS units FROM data GROUP BY region ORDER BY margin_cents DESC LIMIT 10

provenance.sql: SELECT "region" AS "region", SUM("revenue_cents" - "cost_cents") AS "margin_cents", SUM("units") AS "units" FROM "data" GROUP BY "region" ORDER BY "margin_cents" DESC LIMIT 10
